companyDescription: AI drone autonomy + Counter-UAS defense · Sentrycs (Counter-UAS) + Airobotics (industrial autonomous drones) + American Robotics (agricultural) + Ondas Railroad (rail AI) · $40M+ new defense orders in June 2026 · $457M pro forma backlog · The autonomous systems prime contractor hiding in plain sight
priceNote: Up from $7.74 base · $40M+ new defense orders secured in June alone (Counter-UAS, Loitering Munitions) · Sentrycs + Lockheed Martin collaboration signed · Q1 revenue $50.1M = 10x YoY · 2026 guidance raised to $390M+. Earnings Aug 17.
summary: Ondas Inc. just secured $40M+ in new defense orders in June 2026 alone — Counter-UAS, Loitering Munition Systems, and ground autonomy solutions — while announcing a Sentrycs + Lockheed Martin collaboration. Q1 2026 revenue surged 10x YoY to $50.1M and management raised the full-year 2026 guidance to $390M+. The $457M pro forma backlog provides 12+ months of visibility. With only a $310M market cap, ONDS is trading at less than 1x forward revenue — a significant disconnect for a company growing this fast with this quality of government contracts.

catalysts.name: Sentrycs + Lockheed Martin Collaboration
catalysts.description: Ondas subsidiary Sentrycs (Counter-UAS detection + mitigation) signed a collaboration with Lockheed Martin — the world's largest defense contractor. This opens prime contractor channels and validates Sentrycs as an enterprise-grade Counter-UAS system. A formal program-of-record contract with LMT would be transformative.

catalysts.name: $40M+ Defense Orders — June Alone
catalysts.description: Ondas secured $40M+ in aggregate new orders during June 2026 across Counter-UAS solutions (Sentrycs), Loitering Munition Systems, and ground autonomy systems. This run-rate annualizes to $480M — already in line with management's raised $390M 2026 guidance. June was not a one-off.

catalysts.name: Q2 2026 Earnings — Aug 17
catalysts.description: Next earnings August 17, 2026. Market will be looking for: (1) whether $390M+ guidance holds or rises further, (2) Sentrycs/LMT contract update, (3) backlog growth beyond $457M pro forma. Beat + raise scenario could trigger significant re-rate from current sub-1x revenue multiple.

risks: Small cap $310M market cap — thin liquidity, wide spreads, high volatility vs large cap
DoD contract-to-revenue lag: order wins → revenue can take 6-18 months to fully recognize
Competition: Dedrone (T-Mobile), Fortem Technologies, DroneShield all in Counter-UAS market
Profitability: still in growth/investment phase — not yet FCF positive despite revenue surge
Acquisition integration risk: Sentrycs + Airobotics + American Robotics are all recent integrations

macroRisk.summary: Fed risk LOW. ONDS trades on contract wins and backlog growth, not rate-sensitive consumer spending. Key risk is execution on integrations and LMT collaboration conversion, not macro.
